name: Corporate Event Coffee Cart

heroImage.alt: Sip Social coffee cart serving a queue at a modern office event

intro: Proper coffee, on site, for conferences, launches, office days and client events — no queue at a café down the road.
body: Good coffee changes the tone of a work event. It gives people a reason to stop at your stand, keeps a conference crowd alert through the afternoon slump, and gives staff something better than a vending machine on a long office day.

For client-facing events, the branded experience package puts your company's identity on the cart and the cups — a small, consistent touch that reinforces the brand at exactly the moment people are already paying attention.
We work with event organisers directly, so if you need particular timings, a specific footprint, or coordination with other suppliers on site, that's a normal part of planning your event.
highlights: On-brand set-up available for client-facing events
Keeps a conference or all-day event running on good coffee
Pay-as-you-go suits open office or drop-in events
We coordinate directly with your event team

faqs.q: Can you work inside an office building?
faqs.a: Yes — we just need to know about lift access, loading, and where we'll be set up, so get in touch with the building details.

faqs.q: Do you have public liability insurance?
faqs.a: Yes, we're fully insured. Details can be provided to your venue or facilities team on request.

faqs.q: Can we pay per head instead of a fixed fee?
faqs.a: That's what the pay-as-you-go package is for — guests buy individually, so there's no fixed fee at all. Let us know which suits your event when you enquire.
